style: A single glossy 3D icon for a premium fintech app, in the style of Aave's app icons: soft clay-like 3D render, smooth rounded forms, soft diffused studio light from the top left, gentle lavender (#9896ff to #e5e5ff) as the main color with small warm yellow (#ffc42c) accents and crisp white highlights. Centered with generous empty space around it, isolated on a plain, perfectly flat pure white (#ffffff) background that touches every edge of the image. No text, no letters, no numbers, no ground shadow, no background plate, no border.

icons.app: Subject: an app icon tile, a rounded square in deep ink color #252228, holding a smooth glowing lavender ribbon that flows in a stylized S-like curve, like a trend line turning into a spark.
icons.momentum: Subject: a small chunky rocket launching upward along a curved rising trail, yellow body with lavender fins and a soft lavender exhaust puff.
icons.mean-reversion: Subject: a glossy pendulum ball on a thin rod swinging back toward the center, with a soft curved motion arc behind it showing it returning to the middle.
icons.backtest: Subject: a round clock face with a thick curved arrow wrapped around it pointing counter-clockwise, meaning rewind or replay the past.
icons.agent: Subject: a friendly small rounded robot head with a dark glass visor that shows a tiny glowing lavender upward line chart.
icons.leaderboard: Subject: a rounded trophy cup with a small yellow star floating above it.

note: gpt-image-2 rejects background=transparent; icons are generated on white and cut out by scripts/cutout-icons.py.
